# BirthdayGen

> BirthdayGen is a free interactive birthday card generator. Creators build a personalized birthday microsite (name, message, photos, music, mic-powered virtual candle blowing) and share it as a link, mostly on WhatsApp. No signup. 8 free visual themes.

## Create a card
- [Birthday card generator](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/#create)

## Key facts
- Free forever, no signup, mobile-first; pages stay active 30 days (longer with the free annual reminder opt-in).
- Personal greeting pages under /b/ are intentionally not indexed.
- Sister product by the same maker: [Anniversary Page Builder](https://invite.nirbhay.online/) for cinematic wedding anniversary invitations.
